parts.name: Headlight Cowl (SE)
parts.description: A color-matched, rounded fairing that wraps the top and sides of the headlight, fitted at the factory to the SE. This is the 'front fairing'. In Honda's 2026 SE photos its front edge hugs the lens, the crown rises above the light with a small smoked screen set into the top, and the bottom is open. Its shape in the 3D view follows those photos but is representative.
parts.function: Styling, plus a little wind deflection away from the rider's chest at speed.
parts.verificationNote: Honda's 2026 features list 'a color-matched headlight cowl' on the SE; the shape follows owner-supplied Honda photos. Mounting and part numbers are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A2.

oem.note: A HEADLIGHT COWL diagram is listed in the 2026 Rebel 500 ABS SE catalog index; its parts list could not be read.

parts.name: Fork Boots (SE)
parts.description: Black ribbed rubber gaiters (bellows) over the fork tubes, running from the top of each fork slider up to just below the bottom triple clamp. Fitted at the factory to the SE, as seen in Honda's 2026 SE photos.
parts.function: Keep grit and stone chips off the chrome fork tubes and seals, and give the front end a vintage look.
parts.verificationNote: Honda's 2026 features list 'black fork boots' on the SE. Part numbers are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A2.

parts.name: Rider Seat — Brown Diamond-Stitch (SE)
parts.description: The SE's brown diamond-stitch rider seat. The 3D view reuses the teardrop seat shape in brown; the stitch pattern isn't modelled.
parts.function: Rider support at the Rebel's low 27.2 in seat height.
parts.verificationNote: Honda's 2026 features list 'a brown diamond-stitch seat' on the SE. Shape and part number are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A2.

parts.name: Passenger Seat (SE)
parts.description: A separate rounded pillion pad above the rear fender (diagram #8), held with grommets (#7), a screw (#9) and a washer (#10). Its shape and position in the 3D view are representative.
parts.verificationNote: Included at the owner's direction from a supplied SEAT diagram. Honda's 2026 features release does not mention a passenger seat for the SE, so SE fitment is not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A2. Passenger footpegs are not modelled.
